Refund Policy

Last updated September 26, 2026

Try Vanto free for 14 days before you buy. If it still isn’t right for you after you buy, you get your money back.

14 days, no questions asked

You can ask for a full refund within 14 days of purchase, for any reason. Write to vanto@slenbder.com from the email address you used to buy, or include your order number.

How refunds work

  • Refunds are processed through Lemon Squeezy and returned to your original payment method.
  • Your bank may take several business days to show the refund.
  • When a purchase is refunded, its license key is disabled on all Macs.

After 14 days

If Vanto stops working for you and I can’t fix the problem, write to me anyway. Each case is considered on its own.

This policy does not limit any rights you have under the consumer protection laws of your country.

Refund requests and questions: vanto@slenbder.com.
